manifestations.description: considerable pain, particularly in his foot and leg both while in hospital and for two weeks after he returned home
cannot walk as fast as he used to and so has to be careful about distances to be walked
unable to join his wife in playing tennis at a club which she has recently joined
waking up every night in a cold sweat over what might have happened to the baby (for some two months after the event)
some slight pain in her calf (persisting after recovery)
area of Keloid scarring on her left shoulder and small linear scars on her arms; these scars will not fade so there is some permanent cosmetic disability
baby's forehead was covered with blood and she was crying; she did not lose consciousness but merely fell asleep

treatments_received: plaster casts (full length) on right arm and right leg
use of crutches and then a stick

losses.description: Permanent cosmetic disability from keloid scarring on left shoulder and small linear scars on her arms

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: unable to do anything properly around the home for two or three weeks and had the additional burden of caring for the husband after he returned from hospital
waking up every night in a cold sweat for some two months due to anxiety about what might have happened to the baby
cannot walk as fast as he used to and must be careful about distances to be walked
cannot carry out inspections quite as thoroughly as before affecting his work supervising sites

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: unable to join his wife in playing tennis
